title: Young Girl Jessica in Plaid Dress at Park, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot with deckled edges depicting a young girl named Jessica standing outdoors in a park or schoolyard. She is dressed in a classic plaid jumper dress over a collared shirt, complemented by white socks and dark-parted bobbed hair. In the sunlit background, a large metal A-frame swing set stands against a hillside surrounded by tall trees, evoking mid-century suburban American childhood and leisure.
